name: ARCTURUS DEFENSE SOLUTIONS Predator IFF-9 Combat Eye
description:
The Predator IFF-9 is a full-replacement combat ocular unit machined from ballistic-grade synthetic crystal and wrapped in a matte titanium housing. It provides real-time IFF tagging via encrypted squad-net handshake protocols, overlaying color-coded threat brackets across all identified targets within a 200-meter arc. Integrated ballistic trajectory prediction calculates enemy firing solutions and displays intercept windows at up to 12 simultaneous vectors. A sub-dermal micro-processor handles all rendering, keeping the HUD latency under 4 milliseconds.

The IFF-9 is standard-issue among Arcturus contracted security forces and sees heavy use in Meridian's Tier 3 mid-shelf enforcement circuits. On the black market it's a prestige piece for gang lieutenants willing to risk the military-grade legal exposure. Street soldiers call bilateral pairs 'Red Eyes' after the faint crimson ambient glow the sensors emit in low-light scan mode.
installation_requirements: Certified military or licensed combat-medical surgeon; full ocular cavity prep, optic nerve sheathing required
rejection_risk: Moderate — titanium housing requires prolonged biocompatibility conditioning; nerve sheath mismatch common in first 90 days
maintenance: Quarterly firmware update via secure Arcturus uplink; lens crystal polishing every 6 months
specifications: {"resolution": "240MP equivalent per eye", "threat_tracking": "12 simultaneous targets", "IFF_range": "200m arc", "trajectory_prediction": "98.3% accuracy at 100m", "low_light": "Full-spectrum amplification to 0.001 lux", "HUD_latency": "<4ms", "battery_life": "Draws from host bioelectric field, no external charge", "thermal_overlay": true, "magnification": "1x-16x optical zoom"}
side_effects: Persistent low-grade threat-tagging of civilians in crowded environments causing anxiety and hypervigilance
Crimson ambient glow in low-light conditions — makes stealth difficult and draws attention
HUD overload syndrome reported in prolonged multi-target engagements — momentary visual whiteout
Dream interference: users report tactical overlays bleeding into REM sleep imagery
cultural_context: The IFF-9 is synonymous with Arcturus's corporate military contracts across the Great Lakes corridor. Possession without military affiliation papers is a Tier 1 felony under Meridian municipal code, yet the black market thrives because no combat-ready eye on the shelf comes close to its targeting fidelity. Confiscated units are sometimes auctioned internally by corrupt enforcement officers — a quiet scandal Arcturus officially ignores.
known_users: Arcturus contracted soldiers and security operatives
High-tier gang enforcers with black market access
Former military personnel running private security
Meridian enforcement officers (illegally modified surplus units)
Elite bounty hunters operating in Tier 2-3 zones
story_hooks: A decommissioned IFF-9 unit surfaces with an active squad-net handshake still pinging — someone is using Arcturus's own encryption to run ghost operations inside the megacity
A player character's IFF-9 begins tagging a specific civilian as a Priority-1 threat with no explanation — the target has no record, no affiliation, and no idea why
Arcturus quietly offers full amnesty and a contract to anyone who can recover a stolen shipment of unregistered IFF-9 pairs before a rival faction weaponizes the trajectory-prediction firmware
